stories.title: Create Blog Posts TypeScript Data Layer and Index Page
stories.description: Establish the foundational blog system with static TypeScript data structure and index page listing all blog posts with cards. This unblocks all downstream blog features like RSS feeds and article pages.
acceptanceCriteria: site/src/lib/blog-posts.ts exports BlogPost interface with: id, slug, title, excerpt, content, publishedAt, author, category, tags; populated with at least 8 blog post entries
site/src/app/blog/page.tsx renders sorted list of all blog posts in descending publish date order using BlogPostCard component
BlogPostCard component (site/src/components/BlogPostCard.tsx) displays title, excerpt, publish date, author, and 'Read More' link in a responsive grid layout
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/blog-posts.ts with BlogPost type and const posts: BlogPost[] array
File to create: site/src/app/blog/page.tsx as default export function Blog() rendering posts
File to create: site/src/components/BlogPostCard.tsx as reusable React component
Test command: npm run dev && curl http://localhost:3000/blog && verify all 8 posts render
Test responsive: use browser DevTools to verify grid adapts to 320px, 768px, and 1024px viewports

stories.title: Implement /feed.xml RSS 2.0 Feed Endpoint
stories.description: Create an RSS 2.0 feed endpoint at /feed.xml that aggregates all blog posts from the TypeScript data layer. Feed must be valid RSS 2.0 schema and consumable by feed readers.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with <rss version='2.0'>, <channel> element containing title, link, description, language, lastBuildDate
Each blog post generates <item> with <title>, <link> to /blog/{slug}, <description>, <pubDate> in RFC 2822 format, <author>
Feed validates without errors using https://www.feedvalidator.org/ and parses correctly in standard feed readers

File to create: site/src/lib/rss-generator.ts with function generateRSS(posts: BlogPost[]): string
Import blog posts from site/src/lib/blog-posts.ts
Test command: npm run dev && curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | head -30

stories.title: Build Dynamic Blog Post Pages with Article and BreadcrumbList Schema
stories.description: Create dynamic blog post detail pages at /blog/[slug] that render individual blog posts with full Article JSON-LD schema and BreadcrumbList structured data for SEO and Google Search rich results.
acceptanceCriteria: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx renders blog post by slug with title, content, author, publish date, and reading time estimate
Page emits <script type='application/ld+json'> with Article schema including @type, headline, description, datePublished, author, url, image
Page emits BreadcrumbList schema with path: Home > Blog > Post Title; schema validates at https://schema.org/validator

stories.title: Create JB News & Updates Homepage Widget from Curated RSS Feeds
stories.description: Build a reusable homepage widget that fetches and displays the latest news from 3-5 curated JB/tourism RSS feeds. Implement server-side caching with 24-hour ISR revalidation and graceful error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: site/src/components/JBNewsWidget.tsx renders 5 latest news items with title, snippet, publication date, and 'Read More' link to original source
Fetches from at least 3 curated RSS feeds defined in site/src/lib/news-sources.ts (hardcoded URLs for JB local news, tourism board, etc.)
API route /api/news implements ISR with revalidate: 86400 (24 hours); widget displays 'Last updated: X hours ago' timestamp
